fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-10-12, agents of a loan application allegedly contacted the complainant and relatives with abusive messages over alleged dues of Rs. 8,000. The time of the incident was given as 10:55 on 2025-10-12. Rakesh Anand approached Coimbatore South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000340. The complaint mentions Kishore Arumugam, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000189, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Recovery agents allegedly sent abusive messages to the borrower and contacts.
fields.Keywords: loan app, harassment, shopping complex, screenshot, call detail, suspect, morning, mobile number
